description: Technical uses of a word the readiness check of scripts/check-content.mjs would otherwise reject. Each entry names the rule id, a case-insensitive regular expression for the exact phrase, optionally the view it is limited to, and the reason the phrase is not a readiness or commercial claim. Copy of a released SKU needs no entry; copy of any other item, and site-wide copy, does.

entries.reason: The same capability, named in the API Gateway card.

entries.pattern: Source-available under the Exeris Commercial License at first release
entries.reason: Names the licence under which the source of a SKU is published at its first release; it states no production, runtime or perpetual licence.
